title: Warfre's Mob Personality
description: Enhance your vanilla experience with tons of variants and details.
body:
This datapack expands on the 1.21.5 update.

It adds new variants for cows, pigs, chickens, and cats!
These variants include each one of Minecraft Earth, Technoblade, and the 1.14 Cat Vote losers.
Every biome will be full of unique mobs.

Also, stats for spiders, cave spiders, rabbits, silverfish, endermites, bees, zombies, husks, and drowneds will now be random!
Now, any mob you encounter will be unique!

Try it out and see it for yourself!

﻿If you don't want a mob stats to be randomized, tag it whit wu.mp.done
